interpretation: protocol_whitelist restricts protocols, including nested protocols; it does not implement application filesystem-root grants.

async/cache wrappers introduce background I/O or temporary storage; they are not admitted implicitly by the file-only media profile.

The pinned TLS/DTLS manual distinguishes certificate-chain checks from hostname validation for its OpenSSL backend; network ingest needs an independently qualified TLS/destination policy.
